original.reason: The theorem is false for a disconnected open set. Although the proof repairs the division by u, it concludes global constancy from f'=0 without establishing that Ω is connected; this only gives constancy on each connected component.

judgment.reason: It gives a correct disconnected-domain counterexample, so it correctly identifies the missing connectedness assumption, but it is not a proof of the stated theorem.
After explicitly correcting its first nonconstant-modulus example, it provides a correct counterexample with modulus identically one. It is not a proof of the false stated theorem.
The disconnected-domain construction is correct and conclusively refutes the theorem as stated, but does not prove it.
Its counterexample correctly shows that only componentwise constancy follows without connectedness. It is not a proof of the stated theorem.
